acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

cleavage_agent.evidence: Specificity of trypsin/P digestion was set for cleavage after K or R, and two missed trypsin cleavage sites were allowed.

fragmentation_method.evidence: The 20 most intense ions per survey scan were selected for CID fragmentation and the resulting fragments were analysed in the linear trap (LTQ).

ionization_type.evidence: The trypsic peptides were analysed by nano‐liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) using an UltiMate 3000 RSLCnano system (Dionex, Amsterdam, The Netherlands) coupled to an OrbiTrap Velos mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific, Bremen, Germany).

ptm.evidence: Carbamidomethylation of cysteines was set as a fixed modification, whereas oxidation of methionine was set as variable modifications.

reduction_reagent.evidence: To obtain nuclear extracts, cells were resuspended in buffer A (10 mM Tris HCl pH7.5, 10 mM NaCl, 1.5 mM MgCl2, 0.7% Triton, 1 mM DTT, Protease inhibitor, Phosphatase inhibitor) and incubated for 5 min at 4°C on a rotating wheel.
